rows.grounds: compound of kaula and sadbhāva in accusative singular
compound of kāma, kalā, and ātmaka in accusative singular neuter

items.question: What is the nectar whose true Kaula nature consists of kāmakalā?
items.inference: The verse identifies nectar with the Kaula essence made of kāmakalā.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of amṛtam to kaulasadbhāvam remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: Hear the nectar: the true nature of Kaula, consisting of kāmakalā.
